component.name: Fan Control
component.summary: Manage cooling on HP Victus and OMEN laptops

description.p: Manage cooling and thermal profiles on supported HP Victus and OMEN laptops. Monitor live fan speeds and select firmware power modes directly from your desktop.

ul.li: Select firmware profiles (Quiet, Cool, Balanced, Performance) synced with GNOME power modes
Toggle full-speed fan bursts or return to automatic firmware control
Monitor real-time CPU and GPU fan RPM

description.p: Requires HP firmware, systemd, polkit, and coreutils. Enable the background service with administrator authentication; cooling changes then use a socket restricted to your account. Hardware settings remain in firmware when closed.

screenshot.caption: Thermal profiles and live fan speeds in light appearance
Thermal profiles and live fan speeds in dark appearance

description.p: Consolidate app metadata and host commands, simplify setting readback and packaging, and shorten documentation and comments.
Use an application ID matching the project repository and support migration from the previous Flatpak ID.
Automatically set up the OMEN button to launch Fan Control on GNOME, while preserving existing shortcut assignments and user customizations.
Secure the background service with a root-owned helper and user-restricted socket. Repair service setup, bound connection waits, and add an Update Service action for existing installations.
Add background system service daemon mode and UNIX socket support for optional passwordless fan control.
Synchronize thermal profile changes with GNOME power modes and TuneD via D-Bus, while retaining firmware-specific cool mode.
Bundle a static compiled helper for hardware discovery, verification, and session fan controls. Remove host Python and coreutils dependencies while retaining one authentication per app session.
Authenticate once per app session for thermal profile and fan changes. Lock controls from the menu or close the app to end the privileged session.
Replace preview screenshots with live hardware captures in light and dark appearance.
Add hosted screenshots, project and support links, and a signed update repository for a complete software-center listing.
Include the application icon and full software information in the Flatpak installer.
Initial release with thermal profiles, maximum fan mode, and live fan readings.
